cases.question: ¿Cuántas transformaciones no anuladas hubo en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM transformation t WHERE t.annulled = FALSE AND t.date >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND t.date < DATE '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_transformaciones FROM public.transformation AS t WHERE t.annulled = FALSE AND t.date >= CAST('2026-03-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND t.date < CAST('2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué cantidades se consumieron y produjeron en transformaciones durante marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ti.item_type, SUM(ti.quantity) AS cantidad FROM transformation t JOIN transformation_item ti ON ti.transformation_id = t.id WHERE t.annulled = FALSE AND t.date >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND t.date < DATE '2026-04-01' GROUP BY ti.item_type ORDER BY ti.item_type LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS producto, ti.item_type AS tipo, SUM(ti.quantity) AS cantidad FROM public.transformation_item AS ti JOIN public.transformation AS t ON ti.transformation_id = t.id JOIN public.product AS p ON ti.product_id = p.id WHERE t.date >= CAST('2026-03-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND t.date < CAST('2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY p.name, ti.item_type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué asientos registrados no cuadraron entre debe y haber en marzo de 2026?

cases.generated_sql: SELECT je.code AS codigo, je.entry_date AS fecha, je.description AS descripcion, SUM(jed.debit) AS total_debe, SUM(jed.credit) AS total_haber FROM public.journal_entry AS je JOIN public.journal_entry_detail AS jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY je.id, je.code, je.entry_date, je.description HAVING SUM(jed.debit) <> SUM(jed.credit) LIMIT 50
